stories.title: Nitanshi Goel walks for Suneet Varma at Lakme Fashion Week
stories.summary: Actress Nitanshi Goel served as the showstopper for Suneet Varma at Lakme Fashion Week 2026. She wore a wine-coloured embellished fishtail lehenga from the designer’s Kashi collection. The collection is inspired by the city’s heritage, colours and craftsmanship. The show took place on Day 2 in New Delhi.

stories.title: Times of India Fashion and Beauty Awards set for December
stories.summary: The Times of India Fashion and Beauty Awards 2026 will take place on December 20 in Mumbai. The event aims to honor independent labels, emerging designers and digital creators. The organizers state that fashion is no longer limited to designer catwalks or dictated by established brands.

stories.title: Swadesh and Mayyur Girotra partner on textile collection
stories.summary: Swadesh and designer Mayyur Girotra have collaborated on a collection featuring Kanjeevaram, patan patola, banarasi, ikat, bandhani, kalamkari and pochampally textiles. The project explores how regional crafts can fit into a contemporary wardrobe. The partners aim to retain the individuality of these traditional techniques while updating their design vocabulary.

stories.title: Kardo releases Daftar menswear collection
stories.summary: Indian menswear brand Kardo has launched its autumn/winter 2026 collection, Daftar. The line uses block printing, ikat and natural dyeing techniques to interpret Indian office culture following independence. The brand maintains a focus on the people behind production and has collaborated with English shoemaker Sanders and Paiwand.

stories.title: Manchu Manoj and Mounika Manchu sign Andhra Pradesh manufacturing deal
stories.summary: Namasthe World, a startup founded by Manchu Manoj and Bhuma Mounika Manchu, signed an MoU with the Andhra Pradesh government to build apparel, handloom and toy manufacturing centres. The project proposes an investment of 36.24 crore rupees to create an integrated and sustainable manufacturing ecosystem in the state.

stories.title: Urban Pitara uses on-demand manufacturing to cut inventory
stories.summary: Urban Pitara is utilizing on-demand manufacturing and AI-enabled customisation to produce fashion items only after orders are placed. Founded in 2015, the brand aims to eliminate the financial and environmental burden of unsold inventory. The company says fashion should be produced without excess stock.

stories.title: Brandman Retail targets 50 stores by 2027
stories.summary: Brandman Retail reported revenue of 162.41 crore rupees in FY 2026, a 20 percent increase from the previous year. The company plans to reach 50 stores by March 2027. Its portfolio includes international brands such as New Balance, Timberland and Wilson across performance and lifestyle categories.

stories.title: Brandman Retail eyes tier-II and tier-III expansion
stories.summary: Brandman Retail plans to expand its network to 50 stores by March 2027, focusing on tier-II and tier-III cities. The company reported 162.41 crore rupees in revenue for FY 2026. Growth is attributed to its Sneakrz retail format and an expanded portfolio of international sportswear and lifestyle brands.

stories.title: Kidbea opens two retail stores
stories.summary: Sustainable kidswear brand Kidbea has opened new stores in Delhi and Dehradun. The company plans to add four more locations in Gurgaon, Hyderabad, Delhi and Jaipur over the next four months. The expansion targets premium malls and high-footfall areas to supplement its existing online marketplace presence.

stories.title: Adriana Lima walks for Ferrari in New York
stories.summary: Supermodel Adriana Lima appeared in Ferrari’s spring 2027 ready-to-wear show at the Jack Shainman Gallery in New York City. The luxury car brand presented a collection of gender-neutral looks. Lima walked the runway in brown leopard print pants, a yellow tank top and heavy silver jewelry.

stories.title: Halle Bailey wears Le Silla pumps to GQ event
stories.summary: Halle Bailey attended the 2026 GQ Men of the Year event in Los Angeles wearing a black leather dress and Le Silla Futura pumps. The shoes retail for 1,132 dollars and feature an asymmetrical side cut-out. The design is described as a contemporary take on traditional pumps.

stories.title: Brioni CEO hosts New York events for Grand Tour
stories.summary: Brioni CEO Federico Arrigoni is hosting customer events in New York as part of a global journey called the Grand Tour. The menswear brand, owned by Kering, aims to highlight its history and craftsmanship. Arrigoni noted that Brioni held the first real fashion show for men in 1952.

stories.title: Zara Tindall attends Cheltenham November Meeting
stories.summary: Zara Tindall attended the first day of the November Meeting at Cheltenham Racecourse wearing an autumnal ensemble. Her outfit included a houndstooth coat from L’agence and mahogany-brown leather boots from Fairfax and Favor. The royal also carried a Mini Kew handbag from the same brand.

stories.title: Lauren Sanchez Bezos wears vintage Chanel in New York
stories.summary: Lauren Sanchez Bezos appeared in New York City wearing a vintage Chanel mini skirt from the brand's Fall/Winter 1994 collection. She paired the skirt with a black Wolford turtleneck bodysuit. The appearance followed a promotional visit to CBS Mornings for her new children's book.

stories.title: Carys Douglas wears vintage Gucci top
stories.summary: Carys Douglas attended a Gucci event in New York City wearing a black lace top previously worn by her mother, Catherine Zeta-Jones, in 1996. The 23-year-old styled the garment with a lacy miniskirt and tights. The original set included matching leggings, which were not worn this time.

stories.summary: Rosalia attended the 27th Annual Latin Grammy Awards in Las Vegas wearing a white gown by Matieres Fecales. The brand is described as a new guard of provocateurs in the fashion industry. The singer has previously worked with designers like Jonathan Anderson for her tour wardrobe.

stories.title: North West spotted in New York City
stories.summary: North West was photographed in New York City wearing an all-black ensemble and platform boots. The 13-year-old, known for her experimental style, featured electric blue hair for the outing. She was seen leaving a restaurant in downtown Manhattan alongside a small group.

stories.title: India gem and jewellery exports rise
stories.summary: India's gem and jewellery exports rose 34.01 percent year-on-year to USD 2.92 billion in October 2026. The growth was driven by international orders ahead of the holiday shopping season. In rupee terms, exports registered a growth of 44.71 percent during the month.

stories.title: Desert Diamonds campaign continues
stories.summary: The Desert Diamonds campaign is entering its second anniversary, with the brand noting its products have been worn by celebrities including Taylor Swift and Bad Bunny. The category aims to show that natural diamonds can become part of the current zeitgeist.

stories.title: Bulgari holiday campaign focuses on joy
stories.summary: Bulgari has unveiled its 2026 holiday campaign, titled Joy Is In Our Hands. The Roman luxury house defines joy as something created through presence, generosity, listening and love. The campaign features a range of watches and jewelry pieces for the season.

stories.title: Movado updates jewelry-inspired watches
stories.summary: Movado has released new jewelry-inspired timepieces featuring the Museum Dial, a design first created in 1947. The watches are reimagined in a sculpted mini case with a slim bangle bracelet. The original design is held in more than 20 museums globally.

stories.title: Britney Spears jewelry project
stories.summary: Britney Spears is reportedly involved in a new jewelry line. The project is currently being kept secret. The full details are available to subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Coloured gemstones gain market share
stories.summary: Studded jewellery accounted for 31 percent of sales at Kalyan Jewellers in the second quarter of FY27. Executive director Ramesh Kalyanaraman stated that gemstones are moving from the margins to the centre of the jewellery conversation. Retailers are reporting a growing appetite for these pieces.

stories.title: Tiffany and CFDA name award finalists
stories.summary: Tiffany and Co. and the CFDA have selected five finalists for their second jewelry designer award. The program includes a design challenge and mentorship with the Tiffany design team. Finalists will bring their individual perspectives to the jeweler's legacy of artistry.

stories.title: Maison Marcelle launches gold bracelet
stories.summary: Maison Marcelle has released the Equation bracelet, a piece featuring 24 gold modules designed to mimic the feel of fabric. The designer, who previously worked in fashion, launched the brand in December 2025. The piece is part of her first fine jewelry collection.

stories.title: Miss Universe unveils 2026 crown
stories.summary: The Miss Universe Organization has unveiled a new crown featuring 3,150 diamonds set in 18-karat white gold. Created to commemorate the pageant's 75th anniversary, the piece is titled The Radiance of an Eternal Legacy. It was designed in collaboration with a renowned jeweler.

stories.title: Miu Miu brings back zigzag headbands
stories.summary: Miu Miu has reintroduced the zigzag headband, a staple of the 1990s, during its Fall-Winter 2026-2027 show. Hairstylist Guido Palau noted the look is intended to tell a story rather than be conventionally beautiful. A cheap plastic accessory has now earned a luxury house seal of approval.

stories.title: Colored tights trend continues
stories.summary: Fashion retailers including Chanel and Valentino are promoting colored tights for the current season. The trend has moved from the runway to street style, with stylists suggesting a neutral base to balance the look. The hosiery is intended to provide a pop of color.

stories.title: Ugg boots return to fashion
stories.summary: Ugg boots are seeing a resurgence in popularity as Y2K fashion trends return. The footwear has become a fixture in pop culture once again. Gen Z is currently embracing the style.

stories.title: Comfortable pointed-toe boots
stories.summary: A writer has identified a pair of pointed-toe boots described as comfortable for all-day wear. The author notes the search was difficult due to the shape of her feet. The boots are described as slim and sexy.

stories.title: Penny Lane coat remains in style
stories.summary: The Penny Lane coat, popularized by the 2000 film Almost Famous, continues to influence fashion trends. The style is characterized by fur trim and cuffs on a suede, denim or leather base. The coat remains a staple of the boho-girl aesthetic.

stories.title: Gentle Monster previews intelligent eyewear
stories.summary: Gentle Monster is previewing a 16-piece wearable tech collection in New York. Co-engineered with Google and Samsung, the 40-gram frames include Gemini AI and a 12MP camera. The line launches December 10 with prices starting at 449 USD.

stories.title: Casio and A.P.C. release watch collaboration
stories.summary: Casio and A.P.C. have released their second collaboration, featuring two new versions of the AQ-240 watch. The models include a silver-tone case with a green dial and an all-gold finish. The release is accompanied by a short film.

stories.title: Bangladesh garment factories shut amid wage protests
stories.summary: Over 100 garment factories in Gazipur, Ashulia and Savar have halted operations as workers protest for higher wages. The BGMEA warned that owners may invoke the 2006 Labour Act to close facilities indefinitely if unrest continues. The garment sector accounts for 80 percent of Bangladesh's annual exports.

stories.title: India's US apparel exports fall as competitors gain
stories.summary: India's share of US apparel imports fell to 4.2 percent from 4.5 percent between January and August 2026, according to TexPro. While India's imports dropped, competitors like Vietnam and Cambodia saw gains. Recovery for Indian exporters will reportedly hinge on price, delivery and policy stability.

stories.title: Waterless dyeing factory CleanDye ceases operations
stories.summary: CleanDye has ceased operations, ending its use of supercritical CO2 dyeing technology. The Vietnam-based factory previously touted a 100 percent water and chemical-free process. Adidas had planned to incorporate the technology into its supply chain after a 2023 assessment suggested lower emissions. Sustainability remains a complex target.

stories.summary: GURUGRAM, 13 October 2026: The Body Shop India, in partnership with Plastics for Change, is supporting a skill development initiative aimed at creating additional livelihood opportunities for women from waste-collector communities. The investment follows the company's $23 million bridge funding round closed in June 2026, which included participation from existing investors and select new family offices.

stories.title: Oxford Street sparks 16-way battle for former House of Fraser site
stories.summary: Sixteen bidders are competing for the former House of Fraser site on London's Oxford Street following its pedestrianisation. The building underwent a 132 million pound redevelopment. Demand is reportedly driven by limited availability and rising rents on neighbouring Regent Street, where costs have climbed 40 percent.

stories.title: Nike prepares for first investor day in nine years
stories.summary: Nike will host its first investor day in nine years this coming Tuesday. CEO Elliott Hill is expected to present a new five-year financial model through fiscal 2031. Investors are waiting to hear how the company plans to restore demand and fix its performance product strategy.

stories.summary: Frasers Group has appointed one of its senior executives, David Epstein, as the new CEO of Hugo Boss. The move follows Frasers securing majority ownership of the brand in October. Epstein has spent over a decade at the Mike Ashley-controlled group.

stories.title: UK shoppers experiment with AI in fashion retail
stories.summary: Nearly three in ten UK adults use AI when shopping for fashion, a figure that rises to 42 percent among Gen Z. Retailers including ASOS and John Lewis are currently experimenting with AI stylists and virtual try-on tools to influence how consumers discover and buy products.

stories.title: Snitch tests AI mirrors in Indian retail stores
stories.summary: Fashion retailer Snitch has partnered with Flickd to install AI-powered virtual try-on mirrors in select Indian stores. The initiative is currently in a beta testing phase to assess how digital fitting technology influences customer engagement and product discovery in physical retail spaces.

stories.title: Lenskart targets 100 million annual eyewear units
stories.summary: Lenskart is targeting annual sales of 100 million eyewear units in India, up from its current 32 million. The company also announced it will make blue-light filtering lenses standard on its glasses to reduce costs for consumers. The goal follows the company's one-year stock market anniversary.

stories.summary: Emerging designers from six U.S. fashion schools presented original collections at the 2026 Supima Design Competition in Manhattan. Sponsored by the organization dedicated to promoting American Pima cotton, the event invites institutions to select one student to showcase work to industry professionals. The cotton is now on the runway.

stories.title: Edessa School of Fashion targets lower tuition costs
stories.summary: Edessa School of Fashion offers professional training at 100 dollars per credit hour. The school contrasts this with fashion departments charging 39,000 dollars annually. Faculty members include professionals with experience at retailers ranging from Ralph Lauren to Walmart. The classroom is now attempting to connect directly to the industry.

stories.summary: Students at the Milwaukee Institute of Art and Design are developing clothing collections intended for people with disabilities. stories.summary: Target has appointed Sally Grimes as an independent director to its board. Meanwhile, Jason Rabin has taken ownership of Centric Brands after selling the company to himself. The corporate landscape continues to shift through these recent leadership and ownership updates.

stories.title: Career advice for aspiring fashion designers
stories.summary: Breaking into the fashion industry is a dream shared by millions, according to a recent career guide. The path from initial sketches to the runway is described as rarely a straight line. Success in the field requires a blend of talent, strategy, and persistence for those seeking longevity.

stories.title: Vogue College of Fashion expands program to US
stories.summary: University of Tennessee at Chattanooga student Ellery Alm participated in the first U.S. cohort of the Vogue College of Fashion undergraduate program this summer. Previously limited to Europe, the four week program selected nearly 100 participants. The dream of working in fashion is now being taught in New York.

stories.title: Drapers launches annual Christmas window competition
stories.summary: Drapers is inviting independent fashion retailers in the UK and Ireland to submit photos of their festive shopfront displays. Winners will be featured in the January issue. Entries must be submitted by 17 December. The competition aims to find the most imaginative festive creations in retail.

stories.title: Currys project manager wins rising talent award
stories.summary: Martin Snewin, a mathematics graduate and project manager at Currys, received the Rising Talent Award at the 2026 RG Excellence Awards. His approach to project management has shifted from numbers to colleague wellbeing and supply chain coordination. The award recognizes his focus on people within the retail sector.
